hero.lead: We take organizations from AI curiosity to AI-driven operations.
hero.subtext:
We train your people, get your data ready for agents, move your engineering team to an AI-driven development process, and build the agentic systems that do real work.

Everyone has a chatbot login. Very few have anything in production. The gap isn't the model. It's training, data, and engineering discipline.

whatWeDo.label: What We Do
whatWeDo.headline: AI training. Data readiness. AI-driven development. Agentic systems.
whatWeDo.subtext: For leaders who want results they can point to.

problem.label: The AI Reality
problem.headline: You've probably lived at least one of these.
statements: Half your staff uses AI every day. Nobody can point to the ROI.
Engineering trialed a coding agent. The results were “mixed.” Now the team is divided.
The pilot demoed beautifully — then started leaking customer data two weeks after launch.
You pointed AI at the shared drive. It found three versions of every policy — and picked the wrong one.
A vendor wants to sell you a platform. You don't know what you actually need.

entryOffers.label: Where to Start
entryOffers.headline: Two ways in. Both low risk.

offers.name: AI Starter Package
offers.description: We audit your workflows for repetitive bottlenecks, match tools to your budget and privacy needs, set up starter projects, and train your staff hands-on using their actual work.
offers.outcome: A team using AI productively, safely, and on purpose.

offers.name: Coding-Agent Trial
offers.terms: 6 weeks · $1,500 per cohort of up to 8 engineers
offers.description: Week one gets everyone kitted up and productive from day one. Each week after: an hour of instruction and Q&A, then an hour of show and tell where every participant shares what worked and what didn't.
offers.outcome: Six weeks of real use on your codebase, and an honest read on what comes next.

path.label: The Path
path.headline: From first trial to AI-driven operations.
path.intro: Start wherever you are. Engineering and business tracks often run side by side.

items.text: Coding-Agent Trial: six weeks of training and team show and tell on your real codebase.
AI Starter Package: workflow audit, tool setup, and hands-on training for your staff.
Recurring hands-on training in agentic tools, grounded in your actual work — prompting, verifying output, and knowing when not to trust it.
Test coverage, CI/CD, and review gates ready for agent-speed output.
Map your information sources. We guide your team in building and rolling out a data classification policy.

stages.name: Integrate
stages.question: Wire AI into how you work.

items.text: Move from AI-assisted to a fully AI-driven development process.
Curate and structure your knowledge — data lakes, knowledge graphs, vector search — so agents answer with your information, not guesses.
Identify, scope, and build automations and agentic systems with evaluations, guardrails, and measurable value. If the honest answer is "not yet," we'll say so.
We help you hire and onboard the engineer or technologist who keeps it going. No recruiting agency markup.

offerings.title: From Assisted to Driven
offerings.description: A coding assistant is step one. We help your team rebuild its process around agents — planning, implementation, review, delivery — so the leverage compounds instead of plateauing.

offerings.title: CI/CD, Testing & Automation
offerings.description: Agents are only as fast as your pipeline is trustworthy. We shore up tests, CI/CD, review gates, and deployment so agent-speed output reaches production safely.

offerings.title: Up-Skill Your Team
offerings.description: Recurring training in agentic tools, plus the practices that make them work: TDD, CI/CD, code review, pairing. Your team sustains the velocity without us.

business.label: For the Rest of Your Business

offerings.title: Data Classification
offerings.description: We help you identify your information sources and guide your team in developing and rolling out a classification policy. Your people classify; you own the policy.

offerings.title: Data for Agents
offerings.description: Agents are only as good as what they can find. Data lakes, knowledge graphs, vector search (RAG) — the right retrieval method for the job, not the trendiest one.

offerings.title: Training for Everyone
offerings.description: Regular live sessions for staff across the business: effective prompting, verifying output, building personal workflows, and knowing when not to trust the result.

offerings.title: Agentic Systems
offerings.description: We find the workflows worth automating, scope them, and build them to production standards — evaluated, guarded, and portable across model vendors.

aiQuestion.label: The AI Question
aiQuestion.headline: The demo is the easy part.
aiQuestion.intro: A demo impresses. A production AI system survives — model changes, vendor changes, and real users.
